objective: Candidate rotates a pizza on a stone; PR-1902 rolls a shelf through a narrower cabinet opening and lowers it onto four pins.
physical_skill: Candidate requires under-rim peel insertion and support-preserving tangential traction; PR-1902 requires bimanual rigid-panel roll, clearance management, leveling, and precise four-point placement.
success_condition: Candidate requires a released 150–210° yaw turn with ≤50 mm center travel and uninterrupted stone contact. PR-1902 requires the released shelf seated on all four pins, level, square, and pushed near the cabinet back.
reason: The shelf task tests constrained six-degree-of-freedom panel insertion and seating, not planar turning through a thin tool while support remains continuous.
